description: Forensic watermark options for PDF export (DocumentPdfExportOptions.ForensicWatermark and the TmDocumentEditor.PdfForensicWatermark parameter): stamps every exported page diagonally with the exporting user's name, the export timestamp and the client IP. Hosts should fill IpAddress and Timestamp server-side so the stamp cannot be spoofed by the client; Opacity and Rotation control the stamp appearance.
